summary.usage: Should đưa lời khuyên; can nói khả năng.
summary.example: You should tell an adult if you feel ill.
summary.exampleVi: Bạn nên báo người lớn nếu thấy mệt.

summary.tag: Cấu trúc nói về việc phải làm
summary.usage: Diễn tả việc bắt buộc theo nội quy hoặc hoàn cảnh.
summary.example: We have to arrive before the school bus leaves.
summary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi phải đến trước khi xe buýt trường rời đi.

summary.tag: Câu chỉ dẫn và lời nhắc an toàn
summary.formula: Do not + V / It is a good idea to + V
summary.usage: Mệnh lệnh ngăn cấm dùng do not và nguyên mẫu.
summary.example: Do not touch an unfamiliar animal.
summary.exampleVi: Đừng chạm vào một con vật lạ.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: Your friend has a high temperature. You ___ tell an adult.
items.why: Should đưa lời khuyên an toàn: báo người lớn khi sốt cao.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: You should not ___ an unfamiliar dog in the street.
items.why: Sau should not dùng nguyên mẫu touch.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: The school bus leaves at seven. We ___ arrive before then.
items.why: We đi với have to; đây là yêu cầu bắt buộc vì giờ xe chạy.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: Mai ___ wear a helmet when she rides her bike, according to the school rules.
items.why: Mai số ít nên has to, rồi động từ nguyên mẫu wear.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: ___ run across the road when the light is red.
items.why: Mệnh lệnh ngăn cấm dùng Don't + V.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: It is a good idea ___ water after exercising.
items.why: It is a good idea to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: You should ___ your hands before eating to keep them clean.
items.why: Sau should dùng nguyên mẫu wash.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: "What is the matter ___ you?" "I have a headache."
items.why: Mẫu hỏi sức khỏe: What is the matter with you?

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: My sister can ___ a bike, but she does not ride on busy roads.
items.why: Sau can dùng nguyên mẫu; cả câu vẫn thể hiện kỹ năng an toàn.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: It is wrong of you ___ rubbish into the stream.
items.why: It is wrong of somebody to + V đánh giá hành vi không đúng.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: When you have a toothache, you should visit a ___.
items.why: Dentist là nha sĩ, người giúp xử lý vấn đề răng.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 6 · Grammar
items.scene: The medicine is for adults only. Children ___ take it without an adult's advice.
items.why: Nhãn thuốc chỉ cho người lớn; lời khuyên an toàn là should not.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.
